_meta.description: Translator-context sidecar for auth.onboarding. The first-workspace creation screen at /onboarding, shown after signup or to users with no workspaces. Refactored 2026-05-30 (BUG-AUTH-1) to drop marketing-style copy and reuse Lumia DS form primitives. Keep wording tight; this is a transactional, action-oriented step.
_meta.audience: Brand-new authenticated users who do not yet belong to any workspace.
_meta.tone: Direct, action-oriented, calm. No marketing copy. No exclamation marks. Avoid 'collaborate', 'team up', 'unlock', 'experience' — those belong to the marketing site.

title._use: H1 at the top of /onboarding. Matches the form heading so screen-reader users and sighted users get the same context. Keep at most four words.

subtitle._use: Single supporting sentence under the H1. Explains what the workspace is for in one breath. Do NOT mention features or roadmap. Keep at most ten words.

heading._use: Card heading inside the form. Intentionally identical to page.title so the heading hierarchy reads as: page H1 → card subhead (visually de-emphasised). DO NOT diverge from page.title without a designer's sign-off.

label._use: Visible label for the workspace-name input. The integration test asserts `screen.getByLabelText(/workspace name/i)`, so the localized label MUST contain a case-insensitive match for the English phrase 'workspace name' in en-US.

placeholder._use: Placeholder hint inside the workspace-name input. Trailing ellipsis is the existing convention for placeholder copy in this app.

errorRequired._use: Inline error shown when the user submits the form with an empty workspace-name field. Integration test asserts the regex /workspace name is required/i in en-US.

label._use: Visible label for the slug input ('workspace URL'). Integration test asserts `screen.getByLabelText(/workspace url/i)`, so the localized label MUST contain a case-insensitive match for 'workspace URL' in en-US.

prefix._use: Read-only prefix rendered inside the input group (e.g. 'xynes.com/'). Do NOT translate the domain itself. If a locale wants to render the prefix differently for localisation reasons, keep the literal 'xynes.com/' substring.

placeholder._use: Placeholder shown when the slug input is empty. Keep short and lowercase to match the slug format rules.

rules._use: Help text rendered below the slug input. Describes the slug format constraints. Integration test asserts /3-50 characters/i, so the en-US copy MUST keep the literal substring '3-50 characters'.

submit._use: Primary submit button label. Integration test asserts `screen.getByRole('button', { name: /create workspace/i })`, so en-US MUST contain 'Create Workspace'.

submitLoading._use: Button label while the create-workspace request is in flight. Lumia DS `Button` reads this from `loadingText`.

checking._use: Helper text shown below the submit button while the slug-availability request is in flight.

unavailable._use: Helper text shown below the submit button when the slug is already taken (in addition to the inline slug status).

fix._use: Helper text shown below the submit button when at least one form field is invalid.

prompt._use: Sentence prefix preceding the invite link at the bottom of the form. Pairs with `inviteFooter.link` rendered as an inline next/link.

link._use: Inline link that sends the user to /invite. Renders as the active text of an anchor.

conflict._use: Alert body shown when the API rejects the create-workspace request with HTTP 409 (slug already taken at submit time). Integration test asserts /already exists/i.

generic._use: Alert body shown when the API rejects the create-workspace request with any other non-2xx status.

unexpected._use: Alert body shown when the create-workspace request throws (network failure, etc.). Do NOT include the raw error message — that is logged via console.error only.

alertTitle._use: Title for the Lumia DS Alert that surfaces form-submission errors.

prompt._use: Sentence prefix preceding the docs + support links at the bottom of the page. Integration test asserts /need help\?/i in en-US.

docsLabel._use: Link text for the documentation link. Opens https://docs.xynes.com in a new tab (target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer).

supportLabel._use: Link text for the support email link. Opens a mailto:support@xynes.com link.

separator._use: Single-character separator rendered between the docs link and the support link. Keep neutral (a middle-dot, comma, or pipe). Do NOT translate as a word.
